description.p: rayslash is a lightweight keyboard-first launcher for Linux desktops. It searches installed desktop applications and configured folder sources from a compact native Slint window. Optional capabilities are installed on demand as verified modules.
The app is designed for desktop-managed shortcuts and exposes rayslash toggle for resident show and hide behavior.
Refine update indicators, diagnostics readability, update status layout, and project information.
Add verified in-app updates, configurable update notifications, visible version information, and live discovery of new project folders.
Add opt-in, privacy-conscious application-discovery diagnostics and keep keyboard input responsive after Ctrl+Enter folder activation.
Reduce startup and query latency, split module compilation from the resident host, and keep completed timer notifications visible until dismissed.
Polish result stability and ranking, expand time, timer, unit, and currency queries, and refine module settings.
Ship the optimized launcher and module host, make Fedora RPM downloads self-contained, and unify Calculator, Currency, Time, and Timers icons.
Refine module management and settings, improve launcher responsiveness, and add RPM, DEB, Flatpak, and AppImage releases.
Harden installable module lifecycle and publish complete Fedora app and host package sets.
Initial public packaging metadata and Linux integration files.
